name: source-locator frozen battery
rule: Written before the builder or the ranking existed and before any result was read. Never tuned on. Each q is sent as is, with no repo or kind filter, against the index of all eight allowlisted repos. A case is found at k when any of the top k pointers has the expected repo and one of the expected paths. The symbol column is reported beside it (a top-k pointer whose locator is one of the expected symbols) and is not part of the ship criteria.
shipCriteria: Both named misses (m1, m2) found in the top 3, and at least 14 of 20 found in the top 10. Otherwise stop and report.
labelBasis: Expected files and symbols read from the repos at the commits below (public tarballs, 2026-10-23).

cases.class: named miss: code-level fact the docs omit

Which part of the quickstart README explains ephemeral mode versus persistent mode?
